This sales tax, at a rate of one cent per each dollar (sale amount up to $5,000), provides designated funds for economic development, public safety vehicles and equipment, conservation of land and natural resources, transportation infrastructure improvements, and enhanceme

ructure improvements, and enhancements for educational facilities. Pasco County voters passed the first Penny for Pasco March 9, 2004. It was in effect from January 1, 2005, through December 31, 2014, and collected over $320,000,000. In 2012, voters approved the continuation of the Penny for Pasco for another ten years.
